conventions.date: The date the source states for the figure (effective, published or updated). Where the source gives none, the retrieval date 2026-09-29 is used and the basis says so.
conventions.sourceType: primary = the authority's or the maker's own page or document; secondary = anyone else, including sites that reproduce statute text (FindLaw, Justia, Cornell LII, public.law) and press reports of official figures.
conventions.confirmed: true = the figure was read on the cited page during this session. false = it came only from a search-engine summary, a page that could not be opened, or was not verified against the page itself.
conventions.value: null where no figure is published or none could be found; the basis says why.

correctionsToBrief: Ireland NCT: the full test is EUR 60 and the retest EUR 40 from 1 January 2025, not EUR 55 (ncts.ie).
England/UK PPL(A): the CAA now requires 40 hours of flight instruction (35 on an approved ATO course), not 45.
Canada pleasure craft licence: no longer free. Since 31 December 2025 Transport Canada charges a CAD 24 service fee, indexed to inflation, and licences run five years.
UK MOT: the first test is due at the third anniversary of registration (gov.uk), as the brief said.

rule.unit: % minimum VLT on windshield (except top 6 inches), front side windows, rear side windows of sedans/coupes/hatchbacks/convertibles/wagons, and rear window unless dual outside mirrors
rule.basis: VTL 375(12-a)(b). Tint is checked at the annual NYS inspection (DMV inspection page lists 'Check for window tint').

fine.basis: Law-firm pages report up to $150 and no license points; the statute text as read did not state a dollar amount for 12-a.

rule.unit: % minimum light transmittance (plus or minus 3%) on front side windows and rear side windows behind the driver; front side reflectance limit 27% (+/-3%)
rule.basis: CGS 14-99g, as reproduced by FindLaw. Violation is an infraction per offense; repeat violators face impoundment after notice and hearing.

fine.basis: The statute makes it an infraction but names no amount. Tint-shop sites say $100-$150 for a first offense; not verified against the Connecticut infractions schedule.

rule.unit: % minimum combined VLT on front side windows (glass plus film); any added film must itself be clear with at least 88% VLT and the owner must hold the installer's certificate
rule.basis: Vehicle Code 26708(d) read on leginfo, which ties the film to FMVSS 205's 70% minimum. Windshield film only above a line at least 29 inches above the driver's seat, not red or amber.

fine.unit: USD base fine; about 197 total with penalty assessments; usually issued as a correctable (fix-it) violation dismissed for about 25 after proof of removal
fine.basis: Tint-shop and defense-law summaries; the court bail schedule was not read.

value.pre1985Vehicles: 70 for both windscreen and front side windows

rule.basis: Vehicles first used on or after 1 April 1985. Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, reg 32.

fine.basis: gov.uk says police or DVSA can issue a prohibition notice (vehicle may not be used until the tint is removed), a penalty notice, or a court summons, but gives no amount. Secondary sites cite GBP 50-100; unverified.

rule.unit: % minimum light transmission on windscreen and front side windows; rear side and rear windows unrestricted
rule.basis: Road Safety Authority page (403 when fetched) and NCT practice as reported by press and tint shops; a car below 65% fails the NCT.

fine.basis: No published fixed fine found; the consequence found is NCT failure.

rule.basis: HTA s.73(3) forbids colored or reflective coating on the windshield or the windows directly left or right of the driver that 'substantially obscures the interior'; it states no percentage. The widely cited 70% front-side figure is an enforcement rule of thumb, not statute text. For vehicles made on or after 1 January 2017, windshield tint is banned except a strip within 75 mm of the top (secondary).

fine.unit: CAD set fine (plus victim surcharge and costs)
fine.basis: Ontario Court of Justice set fines, Schedule 43, items 195-200 (HTA s.73 window offences).

rule.unit: no light-reducing material allowed on front side windows; windshield only within 75 mm of the top; side windows behind the driver allowed; rear window only with left and right outside mirrors

fine.unit: CAD ticketed amount (70 fine + 11 victim surcharge); 56 if paid within 30 days
fine.basis: Violation Ticket Administration and Fines Regulation, Schedule 3, MVAR 7.05 'windshield or window that impairs driver vision'.

rule.unit: % maximum darkening from solar-control film on side or rear windows (Reglamento de Transito, art. 43, as reported); medical exceptions only
rule.basis: Press reports quote the article; the Reglamento text was not read. Whether '20%' means darkening or transmission should be checked in the text.

fine.basis: Press reports of 20, 25 or 30 UMA; MXN computed from the INEGI 2026 UMA. The press figure 2,262-3,394 used the 2025 UMA (113.14).

limit.unit: dBA, stationary test per the current SAE standard (J1492), vehicles under 6,000 lb GVWR other than motorcycles

fine.basis: Secondary summaries. Since AB 1824 (effective 1 January 2019) exhaust violations are no longer correctable fix-it tickets. SB 1079 authorized a sound-camera pilot in six cities, 2023-2027.

limit.unit: dB(A) at 50 feet from lane center, vehicles 10,000 lb or less (motorcycles 82/86)

fine.unit: USD maximum and/or up to 30 days' jail
fine.basis: VTL 375(32)(b) as amended by the SLEEP Act (S784B, signed 29 October 2021, effective 1 April 2022); previous maximum was $150. Shops that willfully install illegal exhausts can lose inspection licenses.

limit.basis: Not researched to a published figure this session.

Construction and Use Regulations make it an offense to modify an exhaust to be louder than original; the MOT tester judges noise against a standard silencer rather than a meter reading. Type-approval dB limits for new cars (74/72/68) are secondary claims and apply to manufacturers, not owners.

fine.unit: GBP on-the-spot fixed penalty, plus possible prohibition notice
CAD set fine, 'No muffler' / 'Improper muffler' (HTA s.75)

rule.basis: No dB figure. MVAR 7.03 requires a muffler that expels gases 'without excessive noise' and bans cut-outs or modifications that increase noise; 7A.01 bans loud and unnecessary noise.

fine.unit: CAD ticketed amount for MVAR 7A.01 unnecessary noise (95 + 14 surcharge); 84 within 30 days
fine.basis: Violation Ticket Administration and Fines Regulation, Schedule 3.

frameHeightMax.basis: Vehicle Code 24008.5; also the body floor may be no more than 5 inches above the top of the frame. The statute sets frame heights, not bumper heights.

loweringRule.basis: Vehicle Code 24008: a passenger vehicle or commercial vehicle under 6,000 lb may not be modified so any part other than the wheels sits lower than the lowest part of any wheel rim.

otherJurisdictions.basis: No numeric lift or lowering limits were found for NY, CT, England, Ireland, Ontario, BC or Mexico City this session. In England and Ireland suspension changes are judged at the MOT/NCT and must be declared to the insurer.

mustDeclare.basis: Which?: 'If you modify your car, your insurer needs to know – not telling it could invalidate your insurance.' Tinted windows, alloy wheels, spoilers, exhausts and engine work are listed as modifications. The ABI's own guidance page was not read.

premiumEffect.basis: Which? publishes no percentage. It says performance changes (turbo, supercharger) raise premiums most, and security devices such as immobilizers can lower them.

US_IE_CA_MX.basis: Not researched to a published source. Disclosure duties follow each policy's material-change terms.

windowTintUS.basis: Yelp cost guide from 463,691 quotes; basic film about $50 per window, ceramic/carbon about $100 per window.

tiresUS.basis: Consumer Reports 2024 member survey (47,706 members, 52,000+ purchases); over half had free installation. Set of four is 4 x 212, computed.

fullServiceGB.basis: RAC mobile-mechanic quotes, September-November 2025, as reported in a search summary; the RAC page was not read.

otherCountries.basis: No Which?, Irish, Canadian or Mexican tire/tint/oil/brake price guides were read this session.

fee.basis: DMV VS-77 fee chart (effective 1 January 2011, form rev. 7/15); stations may charge less; no sales tax. NYMA includes New York City.

frequency.basis: 'Each vehicle registered in New York State must be inspected at least every 12 months.'

fee.unit: USD per emissions test; USD 20 late fee billed by DMV

frequency.basis: Two-year cycle (FAQ). Vehicles younger than four model years and model year 2001 and older are exempt. No periodic safety inspection for private cars.

frequency.unit: months (biennial smog check at registration renewal)
frequency.basis: Required in 33 listed counties including Los Angeles and San Francisco; gasoline vehicles under eight model years and EVs exempt; newer cars pay a smog abatement fee instead.

abatementFee.basis: Secondary summary; the DMV page read did not state the amount.

smogCheckPrice.basis: Station prices are not state-set; the state certificate fee of $8.25 is a secondary figure.

fee.unit: GBP maximum MOT fee, class 4 car up to 8 passenger seats; no VAT

frequency.basis: 'You must get an MOT for your vehicle by ... the third anniversary of its registration', then yearly.

fee.unit: EUR incl. VAT; retests without test equipment are free
fee.basis: NCTS FAQ, fees from 1 January 2025. The brief's EUR 55 is out of date.

frequency.basis: Cars 30-39 years old test every two years; 40+ exempt.

periodic.basis: No periodic inspection for private cars. A Safety Standards Certificate from an MTO-licensed DriveON inspection center is needed to plate a used vehicle on transfer (not to a spouse); valid 36 days. Its price is set by the station, not the province.
None. AirCare emissions testing for light-duty passenger cars and trucks ended 31 December 2014 (BC Gov News).

fee.unit: MXN per verification (5.625 UMA + 16% IVA), from 1 February 2026; 738 before
fee.basis: 5.625 x 117.31 x 1.16 = 765.45, which matches the press figure. UMA 117.31 per INEGI for 1 Feb 2026 - 31 Jan 2027.

frequency.unit: months for holograms 0, 1 and 2, on the calendar set by the plate's last digit
frequency.basis: Press and the SEDEMA program page; the Gaceta program PDF was not read. One press article says 'annual', which conflicts; the Programa de Verificacion is semiannual.

lateFine.basis: Press reports of 20 UMA for late verification (one source says 20-80 UMA).

US-NY.unit: Boating Safety Certificate required for every operator of a motorized vessel, all ages, since 1 January 2025 (Brianna's Law)
US-NY.basis: OPRHP: certificate is for life; the original must be on board; minimum age 10; temporary certificate valid 90 days. Course fees are set by instructors or online providers; no state fee figure given. Penalties were not stated on the page.

US-CT.unit: USD one-time certificate fee (Safe Boating Certificate); equivalency exam USD 75
US-CT.basis: CT DEEP: anyone operating a vessel must hold a certificate, earned by an approved course or the exam.

US-CA.unit: USD lifetime California Boater Card; USD 5 replacement
US-CA.basis: DBW program site. Phased in by age 2018-2025; all ages from 1 January 2025. Fines: up to $100 first, $250 second, $500 third+. Exemptions include rental vessels and holders of a Coast Guard license.

CA-ON_CA-BC.unit: Pleasure Craft Operator Card (proof of competency) required for any motorized pleasure craft, any age or size; valid for life. Card price set by accredited course providers.
CA-ON_CA-BC.basis: Secondary sites; Transport Canada's own page returned 404. Fine for no proof of competency on board: CAD 250 (secondary).

GB.unit: no license required to skipper a private leisure craft
GB.basis: Secondary; RYA Day Skipper is voluntary but charter firms usually ask for it. Day Skipper practical course from about GBP 755-947, online theory about GBP 265.

IE.unit: no license required for a private pleasure-craft skipper
IE.basis: Secondary. Pleasure Craft regulations of 2004/2005: under-12s may not operate powered craft over 3.7 kW; owners must stop under-16s operating PWCs or fast power craft. Passenger boats carrying for hire need a Passenger Boat Licence from the Marine Survey Office. Citizens Information page returned 403.

MX.unit: MXN, certificado de competencia for patron of recreational and sports vessels, levels I and II
MX.basis: Search summary of SEMAR's 2025 Manual de Servicios al Publico; not read directly. Whether a private owner operating their own small boat must hold it was not established. Mexico City has no sea coast.

US-NY.unit: USD per 3-year registration; USD 50 title fee may apply
US-NY.basis: NY DMV. Secondary sources add a boating-safety surcharge (3.75 / 12.50 / 18.75), not verified.

US-CT.unit: USD, fiberglass or metal hull; wood 15-24 yrs 50%, 25+ yrs 25%
US-CT.basis: CT DMV fees page ($7.50 per foot step in this range). The period (believed annual) was not stated in what was read. A third-party table gave $63.75 for 20-21 ft; the DMV figure is used.

US-CA.unit: USD biennial renewal; separate mussel-fee sticker USD 16 (8 if first paid in an even year) for freshwater use
US-CA.basis: Search summaries of DMV handbook 24.120 and DBW FAQ; not read directly.

CA-ON_CA-BC.unit: CAD pleasure craft licence service fee (issue, renewal, transfer, replacement), indexed annually; 5-year validity; required for engines of 10 hp combined or more
CA-ON_CA-BC.basis: Effective 31 December 2025. Replaces free lifetime/10-year licences. From 2028 sail craft over 6 m also need one.

GB.unit: GBP average 12-month Canal & River Trust leisure licence before the 4.85% rise of 1 April 2026 (about +GBP 58); wide-beam surcharges 19%/38%
GB.basis: Search summary; the CRT news page read confirmed the 4.85% rise but not the average. No registration is needed for private leisure craft on the sea.

MX.unit: MXN (certificado de matricula said to be free)
MX.basis: Search summary of the Reglamento de la Ley de Navegacion; not verified.

newBoatAverageUS.basis: NMMA publishes average prices only in its Statistical Abstract (members free, $2,525 for non-members). Public figures: 215,237 new boats sold at retail in 2025 (-8.8%); average outboard engine retail price $13,081 in 2025 (+3.2%) (search summaries).

pontoonRangeUS.basis: J.D. Power boat shopping guide via search summary.

insuranceUS.basis: Progressive, 2024-2025 policy averages (Wisconsin $274.42 to Florida $867.86), via search summary.

US-CA_MarinaDelRey.unit: USD per foot per month, weighted average of 5 Marina del Rey marinas (1,185 slips)
US-CA_MarinaDelRey.basis: Dana Point Boaters Association survey, fall 2021 (dated December 2021), from marina websites and The Log. LA County Beaches and Harbors publishes no rates; each anchorage sets its own, except county-run Anchorage 47. Rates are now about five years old.

US-NY_NYC.basis: NYC Parks' West 79th Street Boat Basin is closed for rebuilding, expected to reopen in 2028 (search summary). A historical Parks brochure gave $85/ft summer dockage; not current. No other NYC marina rate was read.

GB_HamblePoint.unit: GBP per metre (monthly berth per month; visitor per night), incl. 20% VAT, excl. electricity; min charge 7 m
GB_HamblePoint.basis: MDL Hamble Point Marina tariff, valid until 31 March 2027. Annual berths are by quotation only.

CA-ON_LakeSimcoe.basis: Marina Del Rey (Lake Simcoe, Ontario) 2026 rates by slip.

minimumHours.unit: hours of flight time, including 20 dual and 10 solo, plus 3 each of cross-country, night, instrument and pre-test training

medical.unit: third-class medical; valid 60 months if under 40 at exam, 24 months if 40 or older
medical.basis: 14 CFR 61.23. BasicMed (Part 68) is an alternative, not detailed here. AME fees are not regulated.

practicalTestFee.basis: Examiners set their own fees; figure from flight-school and blog reports.

GB_CAA.unit: hours of flight instruction (35 on an approved ATO course), up to 5 in a simulator, at least 10 supervised solo including 5 solo cross-country and one 270 km trip with two landings
GB_CAA.basis: UK CAA PPL(A) page; Class 2 medical; minimum age 17. The brief's 45 hours is the older figure.

CA_TC.unit: hours of flight training, including 17 dual (3 cross-country), 12 solo (5 cross-country with a 150 NM flight), up to 5 in a simulator

IE_IAA_EASA.unit: hours of flight instruction, including 25 dual and 10 supervised solo (5 solo cross-country, one 270 km trip)
IE_IAA_EASA.basis: EASA Part-FCL, FCL.210.A, which the IAA applies. From a search summary of EASA Easy Access Rules; not read directly.

MX_AFAC.unit: hours of flight (school programs: about 40 visual plus 1 exam hour, 5 simulator)
MX_AFAC.basis: Mexican flight-school pages; the AFAC requirement document was not read. Minimum age 17.

cessna172WetUS.unit: USD per hour, median wet rate (fuel included)
cessna172WetUS.basis: Aether Flight compilation of published rates for 1,586 Cessna 172s at U.S. flight schools; most rent at 150-200/hr; under 120 in the Southeast, over 250 for G1000 aircraft in the Bay Area.

instructorUS.basis: Search summary of flight-school and forum reports.

usedCessna172.basis: Listing-site aggregations via search summary. Vref and Aircraft Bluebook values are behind paywalls and were not obtained.

annualInspection.unit: calendar months; plus a 100-hour inspection when carrying anyone for hire or giving flight instruction for hire in the aircraft

hangarHaywardCA.basis: City of Hayward, Hayward Executive Airport (HWD) master fee schedule, effective 1 July 2025.

faaRegistration.unit: USD per aircraft registration certificate; USD 10 for a special N-number
faaRegistration.basis: 14 CFR 47.17. Registrations last seven years since the January 2023 rule change (Federal Register, 22 November 2022; not read directly).

passengerNeedsCertificate.basis: A charter customer needs no pilot certificate; the operator must hold an FAA Part 135 certificate, which the FAA lists and lets the public search by operator or N-number.

lightJetHourly.unit: USD per flight hour (Citation CJ3 / Phenom 300 class)
lightJetHourly.basis: Charter broker pages via search summary.

turbopropHourly.basis: Charter broker page via search summary.

licenseForHire.unit: USCG credential for uninspected passenger vessels under 100 GRT carrying 6 or fewer passengers
licenseForHire.basis: 46 USC 8903 requires a Coast Guard-licensed operator on a self-propelled uninspected passenger vessel, meaning one carrying at least one passenger for hire, or chartered with crew provided by the owner. 46 CFR 11.467 requires 12 months (commonly counted as 360 days) of vessel operation experience, 3 months of it seaward for near-coastal.

ownerMayHireCaptain.basis: An owner may employ a paid captain. When the guests pay nothing, the boat stays recreational and no USCG license is strictly required; once any passenger pays, or the boat is chartered with crew, the operator must be licensed. This is an inference from the statute's 'passenger for hire' definition, not a Coast Guard statement read today.

captainDayRate.unit: USD per day (Fort Lauderdale private; 40-60 ft multi-day delivery)
captainDayRate.basis: Owner and captain forum posts via search summary; no published rate card was read.

privatePilotMayNotBePaid.basis: 14 CFR 61.113: a private pilot may not act as pilot in command for compensation or hire, with narrow exceptions such as pro-rata expense sharing and flights incidental to a business that carry no paying passengers or cargo.

hiredPilotNeeds.basis: 14 CFR 61.133 lets a commercial pilot act as PIC for compensation or hire. An owner may hire one to fly the owner's own aircraft under Part 91. If the owner charges passengers, it becomes Part 135 and needs an operator certificate. Jets also need a type rating. The commercial minimum of 250 hours (61.129) was not read this session.

pilotDayRate.basis: No published contract-pilot day rate was found.

otherJurisdictions.basis: Rules for paid skippers and pilots in the UK (MCA, CAA), Ireland, Canada and Mexico were not researched this session.

uncertain: Ontario's statute gives no percentage for tint. The 70% front-side figure that everyone quotes is an enforcement convention, and the rule dating windshield tint to vehicles made on or after 1 January 2017 was confirmed only from secondary pages.

Mexico City's 20% tint rule was quoted from press reports. It is unclear whether 20% is the most darkening allowed or the least light that must pass through; read article 43 of the Reglamento de Transito before using it.
The number of Mexico City vehicle verifications per year conflicts between sources. The program is semiannual for holograms 0, 1 and 2, but one 2026 press article called it annual.
Transport Canada's new CAD 24, five-year pleasure craft licence was confirmed only from boating-press reports. The tc.canada.ca page itself was not read.
The Irish RSA page (403) and the Citizens Information page (403) could not be opened. The 65% tint rule and the lack of a leisure-boat license there rest on secondary sources.
The New York boating-safety surcharge on registrations (3.75/12.50/18.75) and California's 20-dollar biennial vessel renewal were not seen on DMV pages.
Connecticut's boat registration period was not stated on the fee page that was read. It is believed to be annual.
The UK has no confirmed fixed-penalty amounts for tint or loud exhausts. Figures of GBP 50-100 appear only on secondary sites.
Whether a private owner in Mexico must personally hold a SEMAR certificate to operate their own recreational boat was not established.

The claim that a hired captain on a US recreational boat carrying only non-paying guests needs no USCG license is an inference from 46 USC 8903 and its passenger-for-hire definition, not a Coast Guard statement.
The Marina del Rey slip rates date from fall 2021 and are now about five years stale. No current NYC marina rate was found because the 79th Street Boat Basin is closed until about 2028.
The NMMA's average new-boat price is paywalled, and so are the Vref and Aircraft Bluebook values for a Cessna 172, so the boat and aircraft prices here are listing and dealer ranges.
